title: Finite component of a generator-normalized strict pullback comparison
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme morphism $f:X\to Y$, a complex $P$ of completed-coefficient module sheaves, a complex $C$ of strict quotient systems, and chain isomorphisms $\kappa_n:C_n\simeq P\otimes A_{E,n+1}$. Use the actual sequence inverse image and its constant-ring finite evaluation comparison [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models, lem-pod-finite-system-pullback-coherence]. Let $q$ be an isomorphism from the restricted inverse-image tower of $C$ to the defining finite-pullback tower of $P$, satisfying the inverse-image-unit generator equation of the pullback realization normalization. At each $n\geq0$, the localization of $q_n$, followed by the unit-normalized finite pullback presentation comparison, agrees with restricted finite evaluation of the sequence inverse image, followed by inverse image of $Q(\kappa_n)$. The source identifications are the exact restriction/evaluation factorization isomorphisms. Equivalently, these are exactly the two maps displayed in integralPullbackStrictFiniteComponent. No derived realization, counit, constructibility, or good-representative hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: Tag 03D3, lemma-adjoint-push-pull-modules; proetale.tex Tag 099N(5), lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case; step 1 of lem-pod-integral-pullback-counit-projection. This is the agent-formulated finite normalization subcalculation, not a standalone assertion of 099N.

proof.text: The completed-to-finite projection is locally surjective: on a cover a section of the constant quotient is represented by a quotient-ring element; lift it to the valuation ring and take its simultaneous reductions. Restriction along this ring-sheaf epimorphism is fully faithful on ordinary quotient modules.

Turn each completed-linear component of q into a finite-linear map using the preceding restriction fact, and transpose under the finite inverse-image adjunction. The generator equation for q, the unit equation characterizing finiteSystemPullbackEvaluation, and the unit equation characterizing integralFinitePullbackModel give the same transpose. The adjunction Hom bijection is injective, so the chain maps agree degreewise.

Apply Q to this chain-map equality, inserting the exact restriction, evaluation and inverse-image factorization isomorphisms. Their composition and naturality equations give exactly the displayed equality.

theorem integralPullbackStrictFiniteComponent {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E Y) ℤ)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)
    (q : (((coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj C)).asFunctor ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P)
    (hq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : Y.ProEt)
        (x : (C.X i).val.obj (op (n, U))),
      ((q.hom.app (op n)).f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
        (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E X
          ((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).obj (C.X i)) n
          (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
          (integralComparisonSequenceGenerator l E f (C.X i) n U x)) =
        integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E f n
          (((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P).X i) U
          (((κ n).hom.f i).val.app (op U)
            (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (C.X i) n (op U) x))) (n : ℕ) :
    (integralComparisonRestrictedEvaluationFactors l E X
      (((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C)
      n).hom ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (q.hom.app (op n)) ≫
      (scalarReductionRestriction l E X n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
        (((integralOperationsLevelPullback l E f n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)) ≫
      (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E X n).map
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map
          ((NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex (integralFinitePullbackModel l E f n)
            (.up ℤ)).hom.app ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)) ≫
          (proEtaleConstantRingPullback
            (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app
            ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y n).obj P)) =
    (coefficientFiniteDerivedRestriction l E X n).map
      ((coefficientSequenceDerivedEvaluation l E X n).map
          ((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app C) ≫
        (finiteSystemDerivedPullbackEvaluation (integralSystemRings l E)
          (integralSystemTransition l E) f n).hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj C) ≫
        (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback
          (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) f).map
          ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app C ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (κ n).hom))
